title: Vancer Ores
description: Adds a new variety of ores, tools and blocks to your vanilla experience!
body:
# Vanilla Enhancer: Vancer Ores

Enhance your vanilla Minecraft experience with new ores, tools, and armor! Amethyst and Enderium bring more adventure and power to the Overworld and the End.

### Features
  - **Silverleaf** – Found in the Forest Biome, Silverleaf trees will spawn mixed with oak trees, they are smaller and very beautiful. Silverleaf boots reduce the fall damage by 30%, making you fall like a leaf! Perfect for early game tools!
  - **Amethyst** – Found in the Overworld just like every other ore, as rare as diamond. Perfect for crafting mid-tier tools and armor!
  - **Enderium** – Rare ore found in the End dimension with powerful high-tier tools and armor. Do you dare to fight one with this armor?

- **Complete Tools and Armor Sets:**  
  - Pickaxes, axes, swords, shovels, and hoes for each material.  
  - Helmets, chestplates, leggings, and boots.  
  - Balanced stats for durability, mining speed, attack, and protection.

- **Enhanced Vanilla Feel:**  
  - Materials respect Minecraft’s vanilla progression.  
  - Tools and armor integrate naturally into the vanilla experience.

### Crafting Highlights

Vancer Ores not only adds new ores, tools, and armor, but also introduces **unique crafting recipes** that mix vanilla and modded items in creative ways.  

Some examples include:

- **Infused Amethyst Pickaxe**  
  Crafted using an Amethyst Pickaxe (D), Infused Amethyst (P), Hard Iron Ingot(I), and Ghast Tears (#).  
```text
  # P #
  P D P
  # I #
```
This creates a powerful upgrade to your existing Amethyst Pickaxe.

- **Infused Amethyst**
Created by combining Amethyst (D), Obsidian (P), and Quartz (#) in a special pattern.
```text
  # P #
  P D P
  # P #
```

- **Hard Iron Ingot**
Formed by crafting Iron Blocks (B) and a single Iron Ingot (I) in a dense pattern.
```text
  B B B
  B I B
  B B B
```

### For Developers

You can manually add the mod to your workspace by placing the compiled `.jar` in your `mods` folder.  
Full source code is available on [GitHub](https://github.com/AfonsoFaria20s/Vanilla-Enhancer-Ores) for contributions, bug fixes, or customization.

### Recommended For

Players looking to expand their vanilla gameplay with **new mining challenges, stronger gear, and endgame content**.
